dedupe_keys.name: lignes electriques souterraines moyenne tension hta dans les hautes pyrenees

description: Lignes électriques souterraines moyenne tension (HTA) dans les Hautes-Pyrénées is a dataset listed in portail Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Agence ORE. Ce jeu de données permet de visualiser l’emplacement géographique des tronçons de ligne électrique souterraine moyenne tension des réseaux de distribution. La Haute Tension A ou HTA (ou Moyenne Tension) peut être comprise entre 1 000 volts (1 kV) et 50 000 volts (50 kV). En principe, elle est en France de 20 kV. Coverage: Hautes-Pyrénées. The portal files it under Territoire. Its keywords are Cartographie, Infrastructures, enedis. The portal shows 8,428 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-ha-py-fr-portal.
